lifthor - claw plus ii lanyard mounting.name: LifThor - Claw PLUS II Lanyard Mounting System for DJI RC PRO PLUS Controller
lifthor - claw plus ii lanyard mounting.description: Bring your drone piloting experience to new heights with the LifThor Claw PLUS II Lanyard Mounting System, specifically designed for DJI RC PRO PLUS controllers. This meticulously engineered accessory offers a perfectly balanced and adjustable center of gravity (CoG) Lanyard System, designed to alleviate fatigue and enhance comfort during extended use. The kit comes complete with two robust aluminum brackets, one for the left and one for the right, each equipped with extension arms. These brackets are designed for effortless installation, featuring thumb screws for toolless assembly, allowing you to set up your system in mere seconds. Included in the package is our latest innovation, the Professional Lanyard - Strapthor ACE. This high-quality lanyard ensures secure and comfortable controller handling, enhancing your drone operating experience. The LifThor Claw PLUS II Lanyard Mounting System maintains compatibility with our dedicated utility and tripod mounts. This means you can seamlessly integrate this system into your existing setup, ensuring you can continue to utilize your utility and tripod mounts alongside this lanyard system. In summary, the LifThor Claw PLUS II Lanyard Mounting System for DJI RC PRO PLUS Controller is not just an accessory, but a game-changer in drone controller handling, offering comfort, balance, and ease of use.
